event: Vermont Green FC defeated Flint City Bucks 2-1 in the 2026 USL League Two Final to claim back-to-back national championships, finishing the season 18W-1D-0L.
Vermont Green FC extended their unbeaten run to 42 matches across all competitions, first back-to-back USL2 champions since Cape Cod Crusaders in 2002-2003.
Flint City Bucks lost the 2026 USL League Two Final 2-1 to Vermont Green FC, missing what would have been a fifth national title.
Deportivo Rose City won the UPSL West Region Final 2-1 over Next Level Soccer, earning a first-ever berth in the UPSL Spring National Finals.
Deportivo Rose City opens UPSL Spring 2026 National Finals vs. Central Kansas United at UCLA's Drake Stadium, with a 2027 US Open Cup berth on the line.
Central Kansas United won the UPSL Central Region Final 2-1 over West Texas Rush, securing the club's first-ever appearance in the UPSL National Finals.
Central Kansas United faces Deportivo Rose City in UPSL National Finals semifinal, with 2027 US Open Cup Tournament Proper entry at stake for top two finishers.
Miami United FC advanced from the UPSL South Region Final via penalty shootout (6-5) over SCU Heat after a 1-1 draw, reaching the National Finals.
Miami United FC face NY Renegades FC in UPSL National Finals semifinal; a win earns a 2027 US Open Cup Tournament Proper berth.
NY Renegades FC won their East Region Final to qualify for the UPSL National Finals for the second consecutive season, returning to defend their 2025 Fall title.
Tampa Bay Rowdies lead the USL Championship Eastern Conference with 35 points from 17 games and a +13 goal differential, eight points clear of the three-way pack below.
Sporting Club Jacksonville sit last in the USL Championship Eastern Conference with 8 points from 18 games and a -23 goal differential, in their debut season.
Sacramento Republic FC defeated Oakland Roots SC 3-1, part of a strong late-July form run, while leading their USL Cup group with 9 points from 2 wins.
Fort Wayne FC hold the longest active unbeaten run in USL League One at 7 games (from April 11 onwards), positioning the club firmly in the top half of the table.
Corpus Christi FC have the longest winless run in USL League One at 10 consecutive games, having gone without a win since the season opener on March 7.
Brooklyn FC sit 12th in the Eastern Conference with 13 points and a -10 goal differential in only their second season in USL Championship play.
Athletic Club Boise topped their 2026 USL Cup group with 5 points, positioning themselves as a potential wild-card qualifier for the USL Cup quarterfinals on August 13.
